name: cmux
tagline: A terminal for working with coding agents on macOS.
hook: Tagged builds isolate app identities and sockets so agents do not control the wrong running application.
summary: cmux gives every development build its own app name, socket, and build folder so it cannot control the user's main app. It also warns where tests miss real terminal behavior and points component work to dedicated skills. AGENTS.md links to this CLAUDE.md file.

techniques.title: Isolate the complete development identity
techniques.body: The build tag controls more than the filename. It isolates the bundle ID, socket, and derived data, allowing development builds to coexist with the user's main application.
techniques.quote: A tag gives the app its own name, bundle ID, socket, and derived data path, so it runs side-by-side with the user's main app.

techniques.title: Remove ambient routing state
techniques.body: The debug helper requires a tag and strips inherited terminal identifiers before selecting that build's socket. It never depends on whichever build ran most recently.
techniques.quote: The helper refuses to run without `CMUX_TAG`, targets `/tmp/cmux-debug-<tag>.sock`, and uses the matching tagged CLI from DerivedData. It scrubs ambient cmux terminal context (`CMUX_SOCKET`, `CMUX_SOCKET_PASSWORD`, workspace/surface/tab/panel IDs, cmuxd socket, debug log), then sets `CMUX_SOCKET_PATH`, `CMUX_BUNDLE_ID`, and `CMUX_BUNDLED_CLI_PATH` for the tag.

techniques.title: Expose the failing regression test in history
techniques.body: The instructions ask for the test and fix in separate commits so CI can show the transition from failure to success.
techniques.quote: Two commits, so CI proves the test catches the bug: commit 1 adds the failing test only (CI red), commit 2 adds the fix (CI green).

techniques.title: Check whether tests are wired into the target
techniques.body: The file describes a silent failure mode: a Swift test file can exist without Xcode project entries and a successful invocation can execute no tests. It names the guard that checks this wiring.
techniques.quote: a `.swift` file in `cmuxTests/` without a `PBXFileReference` + `PBXSourcesBuildPhase` entry is silently skipped, and both `xcodebuild test` and bot reviews pass with "Executed 0 tests". `workflow-guard-tests` runs `./scripts/lint-pbxproj-test-wiring.sh` to catch it.

techniques.title: Reproduce on the reporter's platform
techniques.body: A documented Foundation difference explains how maintainer machines can miss a bug affecting an older macOS release. The instruction makes the reporter's version part of reproduction.
techniques.quote: Test on the reporter's macOS before declaring a repro disproven.

techniques.title: Give all entry points one behavior owner
techniques.body: Shortcuts, menus, CLI, and settings must use the same action path. Optimistic updates also share one mutation path and reconcile against the authoritative result.
techniques.quote: When a behavior is exposed through multiple entrypoints (shortcut, command palette, context menu, CLI, settings, debug menu), implement one shared action path and verify every entrypoint.

steal: Isolate runtime identifiers as well as build output in parallel development.
Make control helpers reject an unspecified target and scrub inherited routing context.
Verify that added test files are actually part of the test target.
Reproduce platform-sensitive failures on the reported operating-system version.
Route UI and CLI entry points through the same action implementation.
